title: Operational Interaction: Cross-Boundary Cell Infiltration x Spatial Graph Topology
rationale_from_screening: Outer-loop CV screening surfaced `min_domain_fraction_ref x feature_concatenation` (W=+0.0128, stability=0.78). Tests how boundary infiltration alters real spatial topology gain (`refac - null`).
expected_direction: Unpruned multi-hop smoothing loses topological advantage under high boundary infiltration.
falsification_rule: Practically equivalent if 90% TOST CI on independent confirmation donors stays within [-0.03, +0.03].

title: Operational Interaction: Spot Spatial Aggregation x Spatial Graph Topology
rationale_from_screening: Coupled with `boundary_edge_ratio_ref x default_clust_gmm` (W=-0.0018, stability=0.42): tests how coarsening single-cell coordinates into multi-cell spots shifts spatial topology gain.

falsification_rule: Practically equivalent if 90% TOST CI on confirmation donors stays within [-0.03, +0.03].
